capexShareOfGdpGrowth.method: Central: broad real info-processing equipment and software proxy (A679RX1Q020SBEA), not AI-specific; contribution net of central import leakage (0.3, Assumed). Interval: leakage 0.0 to 0.6 (Assumed) and, on the high side, adding all nonresidential structures (B009RX1Q020SBEA) as an outer bound that is not AI-specific. Data-centre structures are not separately identified.
capexShareOfGdpGrowth.unit: percent of y/y real GDP growth

circularity.reason: No vendor-financing arrangement has been verified against a filing reference in this lane (6.8). Table is empty by design, not by omission.

earningsShare.interpretation: AI-linked listed-company earnings exposure using global GAAP net income divided by domestic NIPA profits; attribution is Assumed and the denominator perimeter differs.
earningsShare.method: Numerator: sum of a_i x TTM net income (us-gaap:NetIncomeLoss, SEC table). Denominator: FRED CP (corporate profits after tax without IVA and CCAdj), mean of last four SAAR quarters. Concept mismatch: GAAP net income of listed names (global) vs NIPA domestic profits. Non-operating items in GAAP net income are not separated from AI activity. Stale rows (last 10-K annual, not TTM): MSFT, MU.
